game: Prince of Persia 2: The Shadow & the Flame
approach: Native Windows port with gameplay logic recovered from the original Macintosh 68k executable, original game resources, and quality-of-life improvements.
notes:
Levels 1-9 are playable from start to finish, including the horse cutscene leading into Level 10.
Levels 10-13 are now in the game too. They can already be explored, with some of their mechanics working. Original game resources are required and are not bundled.
